blocks.html: Shopping at Robinsons Malls is taking a global spin with “Buy and Fly”, a Robinsons Malls raffle promotion co-sponsored by Mastercard together with Cathay Pacific, Crowne Plaza and Holiday Inn which will run from June 25 to August 25, 2016. Shoppers will have a chance to win one of six travel packages to London, Paris or Rome for every P2,000.00, single purchase transaction made which will entitle to a raffle coupon. To increase chances of winning, shoppers should present their Robinsons Malls VIP card, valid ID and purchase transaction receipt to earn 2 raffle entries. Customers who use their Philippine-issued Credit, Debit or Prepaid MasterCard will earn 3 raffle coupon entries for every P2,000.00 single receipt purchase. Purchases made together with Robinsons Malls VIP card and MasterCard will earn the shopper 5 raffle coupon entries for every P2,000.00 single receipt. Six lucky winners will be drawn. There will be 2 winners per destination with travel packages that include roundtrip tickets via Cathay Pacific Airways; 3 nights, 4 days hotel accommodation inclusive of airport transfers; and P100,000.00 cash. Raffle draw will be on September 1. Participating malls are Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Manila Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Metro East, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place General Trias, Summit Ridge Promenade, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Sta.
